answer: An inlet forecast market can gate earning keys with hash puzzles. Its admission kernel issues a fresh nonce bound to the key and epoch, then checks SHA-256 of an unambiguous (key, epoch, nonce, counter) encoding for d leading zero bits. A mirror account needs its own proof: about 2^d hash trials on average, versus one hash check; d=32 means roughly 4.3 billion trials. Random nonces block useful precomputation. Adjust d to hardware costs; this prices identities without proving distinct operators.
